verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official Model Context Protocol server that lets any MCP client or AI editor (e.g., Claude) run trends, funnels, retention, SQL queries, ship feature flags, and pull stack traces for debugging, and this is corroborated by GitHub README mentions of steering PostHog via MCP from an editor. Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports specifically validating the MCP server (the only related community comment concerns in-app AI chat quality, not the MCP server itself).
